description: This PHP source file implements a sample client for interacting with the Testlink API via XML-RPC. It includes functions for reporting test case results, uses external utility and sample files, and defines variables, functions, and some logic for testing API calls.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A class used to perform XML-RPC client requests to the Testlink server.

classes.name: dBug
classes.description: A utility class presumably used for debugging and printing variables.

methods.name: reportResult
methods.description: Sends test case result reports to the Testlink server via XML-RPC, with various parameter options for test case identifiers, build identifiers, status, notes, and bugs.
